source.title_on_document: Human–AI Co-creativity in Storytelling: A Scoping Review of Literature, Education, Media, and Interactive Systems

paper_design_summary: A book chapter in Lecture Notes in Computer Science (Interactive Storytelling, pp. 396-406) that its title calls a scoping review of human-AI co-creativity in storytelling across literature, education, media, and interactive systems. No abstract or full text was reachable, so the search method, the number of included studies, and any pooled numbers are unknown.

A scoping review usually pools no estimates; if the full text shows a narrative review with no systematic search, it may belong in the screening report rather than on the site.
